---
title: "TAOOH — no-treatment sentinel"
subtitle: "Reduced second-order API/data sentinel before primary fits"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This reduced model checks the second-order `markov.misc::blrm_markov()` call
before the 50 full models. It contains no treatment term and does not calculate
posterior estimands.

```{r}
#| label: fit-sentinel
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "model-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "markov-helpers.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(rmsb)
library(markov.misc)

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
taooh_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-taooh.parquet"
)
surv_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"
)

output_path <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "taooh", "no-treatment-sentinel.rds"
)
dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

if (force || !file.exists(output_path)) {
  data <- arrow::read_parquet(taooh_path) |>
    arrange(id, week)

  # check against survival dataset
  surv_data <- arrow::read_parquet(surv_path) |>
    select(id, event_death, survival_time_days)

  censoring <- data |>
    left_join(surv_data, by = "id") |>
    filter(survival_time_days < 182 & event_death == 0) |>
    filter(day >= survival_time_days) |>
    pull(y_taooh)

  if(!all(is.na(censoring))) {
    stop("Patients are not correct censored after LFU when crossreferencing with survival dataset.")
  }

  bad_absorbing <- data |>
    group_by(id) |>
    mutate(death_seen = cumany(replace_na(y_taooh == 5L, FALSE))) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter(death_seen, !is.na(y_taooh), y_taooh != 5L) |>
    nrow() > 0L
  if (bad_absorbing) stop("TAOOH death state 5 must be absorbing.")

  data <- data |>
    group_by(id) |>
    mutate(
      y = as.numeric(as.character(y_taooh)),
      yprev = lag(y_taooh, 1L),
      ypprev = lag(y_taooh, 2L)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    filter_out(week < 1) |>
    filter_out(yprev == 5) |>
    filter_out(ypprev == 5) |>
    mutate(
      yprev = factor(yprev, levels = 1:4, ordered = FALSE),
      ypprev = factor(ypprev, levels = 1:4, ordered = FALSE),
      id = factor(id)
    )

  model_formula <- y ~ rms::rcs(week, 4) + yprev + ypprev + cluster(id)
  fit_seed <- analysis_seed(config, "taooh")
  fit <- markov.misc::blrm_markov(
    formula = model_formula,
    ppo = ~week,
    cppo = function(y) as.numeric(as.character(y)),
    data = data,
    id_var = "id",
    time_var = "week",
    chains = config$markov$chains,
    iter = config$markov$iterations,
    warmup = config$markov$warmup,
    refresh = 1,
    backend = "cmdstan",
    sampling.args = list(
      seed = fit_seed,
      parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
    )
  )
  diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fit, config$diagnostics)

  if (!isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)) {
    fit <- markov.misc::blrm_markov(
      formula = model_formula,
      ppo = ~week,
      cppo = function(y) as.numeric(as.character(y)),
      data = data,
      id_var = "id",
      time_var = "week",
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$retry_iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L,
      refresh = 0L,
      backend = "cmdstan",
      sampling.args = list(
        seed = fit_seed + 500000L,
        parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
      )
    )
    diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fit, config$diagnostics)
  }

  assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)
  saveRDS(list(model = fit, diagnostics = diagnostics), output_path)
}
```
